scope: All 3,275 candidates have B-U-51 primary lexical/form/sense, complete-span dependency, contextual VI/EN/reading and editorial simplicity review: 304 retained original examples plus 2,971 new complete contextual sentences/utterances. They cover all 6,126 teaching targets, including every declared variant and 466 separate dictionary forms.
